title: Daily Account Pulse — quick CS triage & QBR notes
content:
Morning pulse (25 Apr) — short, actionable.

Top priorities (timebox: 90m):
- PrismCorp renewal (high risk): pricing counter due 2026-05-10. Draft sent 4/22, awaiting internal approval. Need sales + legal call: ask @Ravi to escalate pricing variance.
  - Action: update attachment with last 90d token usage (include peak day) + 95th latency percentiles.
  - Quick ask to engineering: can we surface a 30-day delta on their per-route costs? (log ticket CS-PRISM-COST)

- OmniRetail QBR deck refresh (canary slides): include A/B test outcome for v2 quantized model (latency down 18%, tokens same). Slides to update: 3 (summary), 7 (cost breakdown), 12 (next steps).
  - Draft speaker bullets under "Risks" — add fallback plan if Dedicated capacity dips.

- BetaHealth support loop: ticket #CS-2345 (hallucination on symptom mapping). Customer provided example convo. Engineering owner: Mark S. Need model input logs & eval prompt set.
  - Action: collect 10 reproducible prompts, create eval run in sandbox, tag with "betahealth-halluc".

Account-by-account micro tasks (ordered):
1) PrismCorp (AM call 11:00 PT)
   - Prep: pricing table, usage chart, contract term options (6/12/24m).
   - Risks: finance flagged dot-peaks, PS scope creep.
   - Talking points: emphasize Dedicated throughput guarantees + rollback policy.
   - Emails to send after call: follow-up with calendar invite for negotiation workshop.

2) OmniRetail (QBR 5/2, 9:00 PT)
   - Owner: Jasmine (co-present).
   - Needs: 2 slides on "Cost vs Latency tradeoffs" with hard numbers. Also include Optimize recs (batching + prefix cache) that reduced token cost by ~12%.
   - Dock: attach demo gif of streaming response (30s).

3) BetaHealth (open ticket)
   - Short term: triage + reproduce. Long term: propose evaluation harness and threshold-based rollback.

4) AtlasBank (compliance check)
   - Ask infra for audit log export (last 6 months). Confirm KMS key rotation schedule.
   - Status: pending security sign-off — reminder to ping security "SRE: audit export".

Quick follow-ups (<=1 day):
- Send renewal reminder to Prism finance (template below).
- Assign BetaHealth reproduction to Mark + set due 4/28.
- Share OmniRetail deck draft with Jasmine by EOD.
- Update support-runbook: add checklist for "hallucination" triage.

Templates / snippets (paste-friendly):
- Renewal nudge:
  "Hi [Name], quick note: per our records your PrismCorp commitment is up for renewal on 2026-05-15. Would love to book 30m to review usage and your options. Are you available next week? — Olivia"

- Post-QBR follow-up:
  "Thanks for your time today. Attached is the deck and a short list of action items we agreed on. I'll loop in engineering for the PRISM cost export and we'll reconvene for a technical deep-dive next week."

Open questions / blockers:
- Can infra produce a per-account 95th percentile latency by route? (need for Prism slides)
- Legal on short-term term discount: minimum approver chain length?
- Is there a public copy of the model quantization bench (numbers we can share)? If not, use internal notes but flag as "internal".

Notes to self (rough):
- Use the "Optimize" snapshots for OmniRetail example (talk about batching).
- Keep price options in whole-dollar tiles; avoid fractional per-token language in sales slides.
- Remember to cc acct mgmt lead on Prism workshop scheduling.

End-of-day checklist (tick when done):
[ ] Prism call prep deck uploaded
[ ] OmniRetail slides shared with Jasmine
[ ] BetaHealth repro assigned
[ ] Renewal email sent to Prism finance
[ ] Audit request pinged to infra/security

Small wins (log):
- Got preliminary numbers from infra for OmniRetail (ok, but need 95p by route).
- Customer noted improved latency after change — good anecdote for QBR.

If I get blocked: escalate to Ravi (pricing), Jasmine (sales ops), or Mark (engineering).

End notes: keep this doc ephemeral — move finalized items into Confluence: PRISM-QBR-2026 and OmniRetail-QBR-2026.

---
